turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Hello, this is Igor. You had questions about the frame order.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We are not happy with the last delivery, two pallets came damaged and nobody called us.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: That is on us. The reason nobody called is the driver reported it to the wrong desk. I have the photos, we replace both pallets this week at no cost.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Then do that. And I want a call from you when they leave the warehouse.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: You will get it. Is it still you who approves reorders, or has that moved to procurement?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Still me. If the replacement is clean, let's do the winter order in October.
